original: Setting options for current menu to defaults...
translation: 正在将当前菜单选项恢复为默认值……
正在将所有设置恢复为默认值……
重置所有 IH 设置

original: Hold [SWITCH_ZOOM] then press [DASH] to open menu
translation: 按住 [切换视角] 再按 [冲刺] 打开菜单

original: Set profile options to game defaults
translation: 将配置选项设为游戏默认值

original: Cannot use Equip none on FOB
translation: FOB 中不能使用“不装备”

original: Include addon missions in completion percentage
translation: 将追加任务计入完成度

original: Enable mouse cursor on menu open
translation: 打开菜单时启用鼠标指针
重新加载 IH 模块

original: Cannot restart cutscene while it is paused
translation: 暂停时无法重新开始过场动画
请查看 MGS_TPP/mod/docs/ 中的文档
需要 IHHook 才能使用
请在任务中使用此命令

original: Pressing Continue will continue to ACC instead of mission.
translation: 按“继续”将返回空中指挥中心，而不是进入任务。

original: Navigate menu: Arrow keys or Dpad.
translation: 浏览菜单：方向键或十字键。

original: Switches on logging messages to ih_log.txt (at the cost of longer load times) and enables the announce-log during loading.
translation: 开启日志输出到 ih_log.txt（会增加加载时间），并在加载期间启用公告日志。

original: Start the game in offline mode, this also removes the connect option from the pause menu.
translation: 以离线模式启动游戏，并从暂停菜单移除连接选项。

original: Shortcut key combinations to activate IH features. See Infinite Heaven readme or InfQuickMenuDefs.lua in mod folder.
translation: 使用快捷键组合启用 IH 功能。详见 Infinite Heaven 说明或 mod 文件夹中的 InfQuickMenuDefs.lua。

original: Logs some script execution flow, requires Debug IH mode to be on.
translation: 记录部分脚本执行流程，需要开启调试 IH 模式。

original: Logs game message system, requires Debug IH mode to be on. ALL (same as pre r262 'On') logs all messages sent, RECIEVED only logs those that have modules subscribed to the message.
translation: 记录游戏消息系统，需要开启调试 IH 模式。ALL（等同于 r262 之前的 On）记录所有发送消息，RECEIVED 只记录有模块订阅的消息。

original: Verbosely logs unknown messages. Disable to improve performance with logging and add-ons that use custom messages that don't register to InfLookup.
translation: 详细记录未知消息。若使用未注册到 InfLookup 的自定义消息，建议关闭以改善性能。

original: Stops the konami/kjp/fox/nvidia logos from showing.
Selects a profile from MGS_TPP\mod\profiles folder. Press the [ACTION] button to apply the settings of the selected profile.
translation: 从 MGS_TPP\mod\profiles 选择配置，按 [操作] 应用所选配置。

original: Sets the options described in the selected profile to their default setting.
translation: 将所选配置中列出的选项恢复为默认值。

original: Saves current IH settings to UserSaved profile at MGS_TPP\profiles\UserSaved.lua.
translation: 将当前 IH 设置保存到 MGS_TPP\profiles\UserSaved.lua。

original: IHExt is a windows program that acts as an gui overlay if MGSV is running in Windowed Borderless.
translation: IHExt 是一个 Windows 程序；游戏以无边框窗口运行时，它会作为界面覆盖层显示。

original: Shows help text for some options.
translation: 显示部分选项的帮助文本。

original: Disables the legacy hold [EVADE] to open menu, the two button menu combo [ZOOM_CHANGE] + [DASH] will still work.
translation: 禁用旧式长按 [闪避] 打开菜单；双键组合 [切换视角] + [冲刺] 仍可用。

original: Automatically enable mouse cursor when IHMenu opens. The cursor can also be seperately toggled with F2
translation: IHMenu 打开时自动启用鼠标指针，也可用 F2 单独切换。

original: Experimental: Increses the memory values for various allocation variables/functions
translation: 实验性：提高多个分配变量/函数的内存值。

original: Toggles the IMGui Style Editor to load, change and save the style for IHHook IMGUI.
translation: 切换 IMGui 样式编辑器，可加载、修改并保存 IHHook IMGUI 样式。

original: See IH system menu while in ACC for full options.
translation: 完整选项请查看空中指挥中心内的 IH 系统菜单。

original: WARNING: Sets all settings across all of IH to a random value, which may include WIP, commented out or abandoned options. May also include  Back up your save before using this. This is used as debug coverage to see if anything breaks and not intended for general use.
translation: 警告：将 IH 的全部设置改为随机值，可能包含开发中、已注释或废弃选项。使用前请备份存档。此功能仅用于调试覆盖，不建议日常使用。

original: WARNING: Sets all settings across all of IH to a non default value. Back up your save before using this. This is used as debug coverage to see if anything breaks.
translation: 警告：将 IH 的全部设置改为非默认值。使用前请备份存档。此功能仅用于调试覆盖。
